extension.summary: Daylight - a skin that knows what time it is.
extension.description: Soft, rounded and calm. Its colours follow the day (pale morning, bright afternoon, amber evening, deep blue night) and Home suggests what fits right now: films that end before your bedtime, the next episode, something long when it rains (weather needs a weather add-on set in Kodi's Settings > Services > Weather). Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.13 - Weather hides cleanly without a weather add-on and Skin settings say where to set one; the Mood row shows Kodi's clock.

extension.summary: Duotone - every picture printed in its section's colour.
extension.description: A loud, graphic poster-design skin. Films are vermilion, series cobalt, music acid green: every image in a section is a one-colour print on a halftone field, and the focused item alone bursts into full colour. Giant condensed type, thick rules, a strict grid. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.14 - Official repository requirements: artwork moved to resources/, screenshots added.

extension.description: Your library as coloured card on a light table. Films are closed cards that swing open into a three-panel spread, seasons pull out like a concertina, albums open like a gatefold sleeve and the player controls fold up from the bottom edge. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.11 - Official repository requirements: artwork moved to resources/, screenshots added.

extension.summary: Groove - the record collector's skin. The art is the only light.
extension.description: A near-black listening room (or a warm paper one by day) where whatever has focus glows and tints the room in its own colours. Thin line icons that say one word when you land on them. Music first: flip through a crate, a cover wall, a shelf of spines or an arc of sleeves, travel the collection by decade, spin a wheel of genres, and watch the record slide out of its sleeve and turn. Films and TV get the same cinema glow. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v1.0.3 - Official repository requirements: artwork moved to resources/, screenshots added.

extension.description: A black-paged photo album of your life with films: every film you watched is a print with the date stamped in the corner in orange camera digits, and handwritten notes tell you what you were watching a year ago this week, what you stopped, and what has been waiting since you added it. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.10 - Settings: fixed text overlapping controls. "The words hide after" and "the menu shows" keep all their choices on the left page ("never" sat on the print's caption, "search" crossed the fold), and "hand-placed" no longer touches its pen circle.

extension.summary: Majan - an editorial index for your library.
extension.description: A near-black page, one accent colour, big type and hairlines. Built for movies, TV shows and music on the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v1.0.15 - Home: fixed text overlapping controls. The titles of the Newest and custom rows no longer touch the focused poster's frame.

extension.summary: Nocturne - your library after hours, explored by torchlight.
extension.description: The museum has closed for the night. Every poster, still and cover hangs on a dark plaster wall, and a warm pool of light follows your focus, gliding from frame to frame. Brass plaques, dust in the beam, a listening room under a pendant lamp. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.11 - Home: fixed text overlapping controls. A long custom row name no longer runs under the lamp; it ends in an ellipsis with its item count beside it.

extension.description: Everything moves on circles: posters glide along a large arc into the lens, data is drawn as rings and gauges like a precision instrument (rating sweep, runtime clock sector that shows when the film ends tonight, circular scrubber). Blue-black ground, one signal-amber accent, wide Archivo headings and JetBrains Mono numerals. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.14 - Home: fixed text overlapping controls. Custom rows fit long titles like the other panels (two lines, then a smaller size) instead of cutting them after a few letters.

extension.description: Every picture hangs like a gallery print in a bevel-cut mat, and the paper takes its colour from the artwork in focus. Geist throughout, museum captions, no outlines. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.16 - Settings: fixed text overlapping controls. A long custom row name or path ends in an ellipsis instead of running over "Row 1".

extension.summary: Sentence - ask for what you want, in a sentence.
extension.description: Finish a sentence with the remote to filter your library: "Tonight I'd like a film under 2 hours, funny, from the 90s, that I haven't seen." Every screen talks in full sentences. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.14 - Settings: fixed text overlapping controls. Long custom row names end in an ellipsis and keep their full stop, and the help text on the right no longer loses its last line. Home: with three custom rows, the first row no longer runs over the top line and the clock while the third has focus.

extension.summary: Six Degrees - every direction is a connection.
extension.description: Browse your library by association, like a transit map. The film in focus is a station; Up rides its director's line, Right its lead actor, Left the second star, Down the films of the same year and genre. OK re-centres, Back retraces the route. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.14 - Home: fixed text overlapping controls. The preview map sits a little lower, so its top line name no longer runs into a starter's caption when the title takes two lines.

extension.summary: Void - one thing at a time.
extension.description: The quietest possible media centre. One item in large type on true black; the longer you rest on it, the more it tells you, until the artwork slowly rises behind the text. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.12 - Settings: fixed text overlapping controls. Once the list scrolls, the focused row no longer sits on the key hint at the bottom.

extension.summary: Optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins: art colours, soft art, album spines, queue reordering and a genre wheel.
extension.description: An optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Each skin turns on only the features it uses, and every skin works fully without it. The features: the colours of the focused and the playing album's art, with a soft, blurred copy of the art to light the screen; a coloured spine for every album in the music library; reordering of the Up next queue; the library's genres, styles and moods with album counts, ready to play as a shuffled mix. While a skin that uses none of them is active, the helper stays idle. Album colours, soft art and spines use the Python Imaging Library (script.module.pil), which Kodi installs with it.
extension.disclaimer: Made for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Other skins can opt in; see the API notes in the source repository.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release as the shared KarmaMole Skin Helper (it was the Groove helper): art colours with soft art, album spines, Up next reordering, genre/style/mood wheel and true shuffle, each turned on per skin. Shuffled mixes are put in a random order by the helper, so Kodi's own shuffle setting is never changed.

extension.summary: Album-art colours for skins and Shadertoy visualisations.
extension.description: While music plays, this service takes four colours from the album cover (dominant, second, accent and shadow). Skins can read them as Window(Home).Property(VizPalette.Color1) to VizPalette.Color4. If a Shadertoy preset pack is installed, it also writes the colours and a small copy of the cover into the pack folder, so the visualisation takes on the album's colours. It does nothing for video or while idle.
extension.news: 1.1.3 - Dark covers no longer give black colours: on an album with a black background, Color2 and Color4 used to be FF000001. Every colour is now a usable shade, the four are always different, and the shadow (Color4) is a darker shade of the main colour. 1.1.2 - The Shadertoy pack folder setting is empty by default; the pack is found automatically in Shadertoy's add-on data. 1.1.1 - The shadow colour (VizPalette.Color4) is always a darker shade: on pale covers it used to repeat the main colour. 1.1.0 - Publishes the palette as Window(Home).Property(VizPalette.Color1..4) whether or not a Shadertoy pack is installed. The pack folder is now a setting. Licensed GPL-2.0-or-later.

extension.summary: Twelve skins for Kodi 21 Omega, designed for the TV.
extension.description: Majan, Void, Orbit, Daylight, Duotone, Sentence, Passe-partout, Nocturne, Six Degrees, Fold, Keepsake and Groove: skins designed for the TV and tested on an NVIDIA Shield, plus two optional helper add-ons. Install a skin from this repository and its updates arrive automatically.
